about: Line maps between the theory texts. Each map sends a line of the earlier text to a line of the later text or to null. kind: equal (same line), changed (paired by similarity inside a changed block), moved (paired by similarity across the text), removed (no partner). Lines are 1-based. Blank lines and rules are mapped too.

f10.label: file 10
f10.path: authority/10 Claude Fable Semantics - standalone theory.md

f11.label: file 11
f11.path: authority/11 Claude Fable Semantics - standalone theory, revision 1.md

d1.label: file 13 draft 1 (as sent)
d1.path: tests/Revision 2 - file 13 draft, theory text, as sent for cross-examination.md

d2.label: file 13 draft 2 (as sent)
d2.path: tests/Revision 2 - file 13 draft 2, theory text, as sent for cross-examination.md

scrubbed.path: tests/Revision 2 - file 13 draft 5, scrubbed of verificationist words, theory text.md

repaired.label: repaired copy

latest.label: latest text
latest.path: tests/Revision 2 - scrubbed copy, repaired (S96), after cross-examination, theory text.md

f10->f11.method: difflib at line level; changed blocks paired by similarity (ratio >= 0.3), then unpaired lines paired across the text (ratio >= 0.6) as moved; lines still unpaired then placed by the sentence-level map (the file-11 line of their most similar sentence)

f11->d1.method: difflib at line level; changed blocks paired by similarity (ratio >= 0.3), then unpaired lines paired across the text (ratio >= 0.6) as moved

d1->d2.method: difflib at line level; changed blocks paired by similarity (ratio >= 0.3), then unpaired lines paired across the text (ratio >= 0.6) as moved

d3->d4.method: difflib at line level; changed blocks paired by similarity (ratio >= 0.3), then unpaired lines paired across the text (ratio >= 0.6) as moved

d4->d5.method: difflib at line level; changed blocks paired by similarity (ratio >= 0.3), then unpaired lines paired across the text (ratio >= 0.6) as moved

d5->scrubbed.method: line for line (the texts keep the same lines)

scrubbed->repaired.method: line for line (the texts keep the same lines)

repaired->latest.method: line for line (the texts keep the same lines)
